value.body: A cost and management accountant is a member of the Institute of Cost Accountants of India (ICMAI) who works on product costing, budgeting, cost control and cost audit. CMAs work in manufacturing and service companies, and in practice, where the Companies Act reserves cost audit for practising cost accountants. Work includes cost sheets, variance analysis, budgets, cost records and audit reports.

items.label: Cost audit rules
items.note: Apply to specified industries above turnover limits

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Register with ICMAI for the Foundation after Class 12, or enter directly at Intermediate as a graduate. Clear Intermediate and Final and complete the practical training to become a member. Cost audit practice needs ICMAI's certificate of practice; others join companies as cost or management accountants.

value.title: Skills you'll use
items: Maintaining cost records under the cost audit rules

value.title: At a glance
items: Common roles include cost accountant, cost controller, FP&A analyst and finance manager.
Manufacturing-heavy regions tend to have more costing roles.
Cost audit work depends on which companies fall under the cost audit rules each year.
